scoring_justification: Recompute transmission inhibition ratios from the raw CSV: locate frequency nearest to ω1=0.863 and ω2=0.978 and verify center/side ratios exceed 5.

outputs.description: Normalized transmission spectra in center and side beam directions as a function of frequency around the Dirac cone.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute inhibition ratios from this CSV at specific hidden frequencies and check that the center-to-side ratio and side-to-center ratio each exceed an order-of-magnitude threshold.

steps.description: Verify CSV has at least 100 rows covering [0.85,1.0].

At ω1=0.863 (lower cone) require transmission_center/transmission_side ≥ 5. At ω2=0.978 (upper cone) require transmission_side/transmission_center ≥ 5. Both conditions must hold for full credit; one hold yields 0.5.
